crossRefs.note: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior…
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

translations.web: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
translations.bsb: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
translations.kjv: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
translations.asv: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
